## Triage: first grade, `domain:ui` · `area:api` · `pm:queue` · triage seat · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-16T22:55Z

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015). ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Why p2 (the filer's):** every console open loads the whole object registry (745 KB). It is a cost, not a defect, on most pages.
- **For the claimant:** If scoping per app needs a server-side filter on `/api/v1/meta/object` that the door does not declare, that is an objectstack card (a door change, protocol-first), filed under the self-split rule. ⛔ No client-side guess at an undeclared parameter.

Claim: PM loop round 3 (`priority:p2` enhancement; filed by the `repo:cloud#1` seat as the registry half of objectstack-ai/cloud#2914, the 13 s console open, and graded by the triage seat, `6226228345`; serial after objectui#12809, which landed as PR objectstack-ai/objectui#12855)
Session: `session_01SJn1GEkrbbBQkhGC26wEDw`
Account: `os-sales` (the seat's linked user as `GET /user` answers it; the card's assignee)
Branch: `claude/issue-12811-scoped-object-metadata`
Worktree: `objectui-issue-12811` (in the cloud session's own container)
Domain: `domain:ui`
Seat: `domain:ui#4`
File surface: `packages/app-shell/src/providers/MetadataProvider.tsx` (a package-scoped object read beside the whole-registry one, and a by-name read for an object outside the app's package); the console open path's readers of `useMetadata().objects`, each named in the report: `packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx`, `packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useActionModal.tsx` (from `ConsoleShell.tsx`), `packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useNavMemberGates.ts`, the chrome's `CommandPalette` and `ConsoleLayout` props, `useTrackRouteAsRecent`; tests beside each; one `.changeset/12811-*.md` per released package touched. ⛔ `packages/components/src/ui/**` and every server-side file stay out of bounds; the `?package=` scope is used as the framework's list door declares it. Stop on breach; explain in the report.
Container & model: `L`, `mode:cloud`, `model: opus` (cloud on the maintainer's stance 「可以的话，ui 后续开发尽量用云 session，并且要求截图给我看」; lane scope on 「你也可以接ui车道的卡」; batch 3 on 「当前任务处理完，后续并发降到3」, this session's chat, 2026-10-16)
Clause-②: yes
Clause-② reason: `@object-ui/app-shell` exports `useMetadata` and `MetadataProvider`; the context may take a member for the scoped read, and when the open path's object definitions resolve changes. «拿不准 ⇒ 按 yes». The seat's `TIER_DEFAULT` review comes before ready.
Responsibility: n/a — a measured whole-registry read on every console open
Thread-read: 6226228345
Serial constraints cleared: objectui#12809 (the same `AppContent` gate and boot path) landed as PR objectstack-ai/objectui#12855, and this branch is cut from `main` after it. No other open objectui PR touches `MetadataProvider.tsx`, `AppContent.tsx`, `useActionModal.tsx` or `useNavMemberGates.ts` (read at dispatch). The door: objectstack's `GET /api/v1/meta/:type` list handler reads `?package=` (`metaItemPackageBinding(req.query?.package)`, ADR-0048), and `@objectstack/client`'s `meta.getItems(type, { packageId })` sends it, so no undeclared parameter is guessed (the triage note's condition).
